projection_provenance.scope: Projection is rendering geometry, not construction ownership. Complete attachment overhangs are authorized only by exact independently audited output hashes; whole-union traffic support is mandatory. Areas sum indexed projected triangles, including overlapping decks and barrier bands; they are not a planar union area.

model_seams.scope: Saved full-width pavement and barrier-profile samples; continuous car corridors are checked per piece. This is not structural engineering or a complete vehicle-body proof.

supports.scope: Saved vertical faces, indexed road-plane contacts, and conservative saved-PATH car corridors; structural load capacity and in-game collision behaviour are unverified.

inherited_dd_encoding_precision.scope: The unchanged finite-edge rectangle/endpoint-disc proof applies only to exact frozen inherited branch cells and affirmative flat DD faces. Every admitted interval is recorded; outside those cells strict support is mandatory.

complete_model_union_traffic.scope: Actual complete indexed-model union supports every saved car PATH segment and clears its declared narrow solid prism. This is not game operation or a complete swept vehicle body.

limits: This is the literal compact alternative, not a promise about arbitrary module combinations.
Saved geometry and traffic checks do not establish native MIS compatibility or game behavior.
